verdict.rationale: Supermemory's graph memory and profile docs describe automatic fact extraction, contradiction handling, and expiring outdated information (e.g. 'handles knowledge updates and contradictions, forgets expired information'), which implies some temporal awareness, but there is no documented mechanism for explicitly tracking valid-from/valid-until timestamps or querying facts by time validity. Missing for 10: explicit temporal metadata/fields for fact validity windows, API/search support for querying 'as of' a point in time, and any hands-on evidence confirming temporal reasoning works as described.
